name: Tillorbit
tagline: Money that moves like you do.
positioning: Tillorbit is a consumer-first payments app that makes paying, splitting and getting paid feel as fluid as a tap, for people and the independent shops they love.
audience: Digitally native 20-40 year-olds who share costs with friends, plus independent shop owners who want simple, transparent card acceptance.
strategy: Lead with motion and clarity: every touchpoint shows money in orbit, moving smoothly from tap to settled. Pair vibrant consumer-tech energy with plain-language explainers so trust grows from understanding, never from hype or promised outcomes.

designSystem.spacing: 8px base grid; section padding 96-128px desktop, 64px mobile; generous 24px bento gaps
designSystem.radius: Soft and pill-shaped: 28px cards, 999px buttons and chips, 40px large panels
designSystem.borders: Hairline 1-2px borders in ink at 10-16% opacity; glass panels on dark use lavender at 6% fill
designSystem.imagery: Original vector only: floating card and receipt mockups, phones and terminals as simple geometric UI, never photos
designSystem.shapes: Tilted ellipses (orbits), circles, pills; blurred radial gradient blobs in violet, pink and mint
designSystem.buttons: Pill buttons; primary violet with white label, secondary mint with ink label, ghost with ink outline; arrow glyph for forward actions
designSystem.cards: White floating cards with soft violet-tinted drop shadow, slight rotation (-8 to 6 degrees) when shown as mockups; bento tiles with mixed spans
designSystem.motifs: Orbital rings at -12 to -24 degrees, satellite dots in mint, gradient motion trails fading along an orbit arc, floating UI chips

artDirection: Every creative centres on an orbit: a tilted ring system with a hero object (card, receipt, terminal or phone) at its core and UI chips floating around it. Use the violet-to-pink gradient for the hero object and one motion trail per composition, with mint reserved for success states and satellite dots. Keep headlines in heavy Outfit with tight tracking and a single violet or mint highlight word; supporting copy in Plus Jakarta Sans stays short and factual. Alternate light lavender and deep-space backgrounds across a feed to keep rhythm, and always label sample figures as illustrative.
